title: Say how to add something new on screen: grow Action, one case in runAction
body:
Closes a gap in the "what {A} does is data" rules. Nothing said what to do when a character needs something no `Action` can show yet, like a second mini game or a new kind of screen. An agent following the guard might have pushed it into `do` by reaching into React state, or decided it was blocked.

Now three places give the same answer: `src/game/CLAUDE.md` (a new section, "Something new on screen"), the comment at the top of `src/game/actions.ts`, and the guard's failure message. The answer:
1. Add the new value or kind to `Action`.
2. Add one case to App's `runAction`, plus its overlay. This is allowed, because the guard only blocks branches in `onInteract`.
3. Return it from the plugin's `act()`, test it with `pick()`, and optionally add a `?open=` link.

Docs and comments only, no behaviour change. 473 tests pass and the type check is clean.

Mike: heads-up. This is guidance your Claude will read when a character needs a new screen.

## Story

Idea: Make sure every agent knows how to add a new kind of screen without breaking the pattern.
Where: none
Tags: agent
Asked vs made: Asked to close the gap found while reviewing whether Mike's agents can work with the new setup. Made a short section in the docs and a line in the guard's message.
Mike:
